claims.claim: Funeral Support Payment helps people in Scotland pay funeral costs.
claims.quote: Funeral Support Payment helps pay for funeral costs if you live in Scotland.
claims.note: The overview directly states the purpose and residence condition.

claims.claim: Receiving a qualifying benefit is an eligibility condition.
claims.quote: You or your partner must get one or more of the following: Universal Credit (UC) Income Support Pension Credit Housing Benefit income-based Jobseeker's Allowance (JSA), not contribution-based JSA income-related Employment and Support Allowance (ESA), not contribution-based ESA
claims.note: The eligibility page lists the qualifying benefits.

claims.claim: A person awaiting a decision on a qualifying benefit can apply.
claims.quote: If you or your partner are waiting to hear about your application for one of these benefits, you can still apply for Funeral Support Payment.
claims.note: The page explicitly permits an application while a benefit decision is pending.

claims.claim: The payment usually covers the burial, cremation or hydrolysis cost in Scotland.
claims.quote: The payment will usually cover the cost of burial, cremation or hydrolysis in Scotland.
claims.note: The figure is stated on the page for funerals of people aged 18 or over, not established for every baby or child funeral in the summary.

claims.claim: The payment includes £1,327.75 towards other funeral costs.
claims.quote: You can get a payment of £1,327.75 to put towards any other funeral costs you need to pay for, such as the funeral service or funeral car.
claims.note: The amount is stated for funerals of people aged 18 or over; the summary does not limit it to that age group.

claims.claim: The amount for other funeral costs is reduced to £162.05 if the deceased had a funeral plan.
claims.quote: If the person who died had a funeral plan, the amount you'll get for funeral costs will be reduced to £162.05.
claims.note: The reduced amount is stated for funerals of people aged 18 or over; the summary does not limit it to that age group.

claims.claim: The payment can help with some travel, transport, document and medical costs.
claims.quote: It can help pay towards: burial, cremation or hydrolysis costs funeral costs your travel costs transport costs to move the person who died document costs medical costs
claims.note: These cost categories are listed for funerals of people aged 18 or over, not all child funerals.

claims.claim: The payment includes funerals of babies and stillborn babies.
claims.quote: You can use the payment towards funeral costs for a baby, child or adult. This includes babies who were stillborn.

claims.claim: Applications can be made after the death until six months after the funeral.
claims.quote: you're applying after the person has died, until 6 months after the date of their funeral
claims.note: The eligibility page explicitly gives this window, with some exceptions for late applications.
